All 8 sampled checkout client spans for oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge are errored: 8 rows with {error=True; otel.status_code=ERROR; rpc.grpc.status_code=2}, durations 8883-27842 us, each carrying otel.status_description 'Payment request failed. Payment service spans in the same traces show 8 errored grpc.oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge spans (durations 3361-22223 us) with error detail grpc.error_message/exception.message 'Payment request failed. Invalid token. app.loyalty.level=gold' and exception.stacktrace pointing at module.exports.charge (/usr/src/app/charge.js:37:13). These payment server spans reference as parent the corresponding checkout client Charge spans (e.g. span_id f39b005ff3953014 parent 13e908728553c553, b79dc0a42192145e parent ad651027f967757a, c2127f0f6022ea64 parent ba0aa7ba3634b114). Payment span-call metric for the window shows STATUS_CODE_ERROR increase 8.333379629886833 (grpc.oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge, STATUS_CODE_ERROR) and STATUS_CODE_UNSET increase 10.00012500156252.

The non-payment checkout dependencies exercised in the sampled traces show no failures: checkout client spans for oteldemo.CartService/GetCart (8 rows, rpc.grpc.status_code=0), oteldemo.CurrencyService/Convert (22 rows, rpc.grpc.status_code=0), oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/GetProduct (14 rows, rpc.grpc.status_code=0) and oteldemo.ShippingService/GetQuote (8 rows, rpc.grpc.status_code=0); shipping server spans oteldemo.ShippingService/GetQuote (8 rows, rpc.grpc.status_code=0) and shipping 'POST' (8 rows, http.status_code=200). For the email service the span-call series returned in the window shows status_code=STATUS_CODE_UNSET with an increase of 0, and no email spans appear in either sampled checkout or sampled payment trace view; the sampled traces do not show checkout reaching an email step.

The reported checkout error elevation is driven by payment rejecting the Charge call (a functional authorization failure, 'Invalid token', tied to app.loyalty.level=gold), which checkout surfaces as gRPC code 13 and frontend as HTTP 500, rather than by checkout's own logic or by latency. This is a causal reading of the supplied parent references and error text, not a demonstrated root cause; the token-validation and loyalty-level path was not itself inspected.

Hypothesis that checkout's dependency calls to product-catalog, cart, currency or shipping were failing or returning errors in the window is not supported by the returned evidence: their checkout client spans carry rpc.grpc.status_code=0 and no ERROR-labelled increase was returned for those services.

Hypothesis that failures in the window extended across all listed dependencies including email is not supported: email shows a 0 increase and no error status, and no email spans were returned in the sampled traces, so the email path was not observed as failing.

Not all checkout dependency interactions are error-free in the window in the sense of coverage: the payment service also returned STATUS_CODE_UNSET increase 10.00012500156252 alongside its 8.33 ERROR increase, and checkout returned UNSET 65.0 alongside 16.67 ERROR, so part of the observed span volume is non-error and the sampled view is not a complete failure rate.
